hyperscaler_financials.historical_method: retain only facts whose filed date is <= as_of_date

ai_constituents.historical_method: only archived effective-date snapshots may be used

a_share_margin.fallback_method: If SZSE history does not reach the expected point-in-time cutoff, use one consistent full-window SSE-only proxy, label it unverified, and never splice SSE-only rows onto an earlier combined series.

us_liquidity.supplemental: U.S. Treasury Daily Treasury Rates XML for newer nominal and real-yield observations
us_liquidity.brent_inflation_veto: FRED DCOILBRENTEU; ADD is blocked by a 5-session increase of at least 5% or Brent at or above $105/bbl
us_liquidity.exact_dxy: not supplied; DTWEXBGS is stored as broad_dollar and never relabelled DXY
us_liquidity.historical_method: archived vintage required for official output; explicit current-vintage research replay is unverified

china_inflation.primary: National Bureau of Statistics series via AkShare adapter
china_inflation.availability_rule: 45-calendar-day conservative lag when exact release metadata is unavailable
china_inflation.historical_method: current-vintage historical replay is unverified; official use requires an archived artifact

margin_leverage_ratio.reason: no automated point-in-time official free-float market-cap denominator is implemented
